settings.title: Settings
settings.autoSyncHint: While on Home or Mail, new mail is synced automatically at the set interval (opening Home/Mail always syncs). Minimum 10 seconds.
settings.homeCountHint: Show a number next to each account on Home (inbox only).
settings.inlineImagesHint: Automatically fetch inline images bundled in the message and show them in the body. Remote (external) images stay blocked.
settings.remoteImagesHint: How external (remote) images in HTML mail are shown by default. Hidden by default for privacy. You can switch per message; senders you 'always allow' are shown regardless.
settings.bubbleHtmlHint: Draws collapsed chat bubbles from the HTML body for mail without quotes (e.g. newsletters), keeping links and formatting. Replies that contain quotes stay as plain, new-part-only text to keep the chat feel. Images are not fetched and stay as placeholders — lightweight, with no external-image tracking.
settings.flyAnimationHint: Turns the send button into a swallow that flies across the window to deliver your letter while sending. When off, a plain "Send" button is used.
settings.spamEnabledHint: Classify incoming mail locally on your device. Learning stays on your machine; message content is never sent to a server.
settings.spamThresholdHighHint: Scores at or above this move to the Spam folder (higher = safer, fewer false positives).
settings.spamThresholdLowHint: Scores from here up to the quarantine threshold stay in the inbox with a subtle warning.
settings.spamPreviewNote: Preview only — changes aren't saved yet (they take effect in the app).
settings.phoneHint: Type just the national number and it is stored as [country] + [national number] using your default country (internally E.164).
settings.postalAutoformatHint: Automatically format Japanese postal codes (7 digits) as NNN-NNNN.
settings.trashHint: Deleted contacts/organizations aren't removed immediately; they stay in the trash for a while, then are permanently deleted. Merging does not count as deletion.
settings.trashPurgeConfirm: Permanently delete trash older than the retention period. Continue?
settings.mailTrashHint: Deleted mail isn't removed immediately; it stays in the trash for a while, then is permanently deleted. In the trash, use "Restore" to move it back to its original folder.
settings.mailTrashPurgeConfirm: Permanently delete mail older than the retention period. Continue?
settings.gcalIntro: Sync two-way with Google Calendar. Events you create, edit, or delete in Rondine are pushed to Google, and changes on Google are pulled into Rondine.
settings.gcalCredentialsHint: Create a "Desktop app" OAuth client in Google Cloud Console and paste its client ID and secret here (test-user mode is fine).
settings.gcalDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect this account? The imported Google calendars and events will be removed from Rondine (events on Google are not deleted).
settings.gcalSyncDone: Sync done: {{pulled}} pulled / {{pushed}} pushed / {{deletedIn}} deleted-in / {{deletedOut}} deleted-out
settings.gcalNeedCredentials: Save the OAuth client credentials first.
settings.gcalTestUserNote: For an OAuth app in testing status, the authorization (refresh token) expires after about 7 days. If "Sync now" starts failing, just connect again.

dataloc.title: Data location
dataloc.hint: Where the mail database and attachment cache are stored. Move it to another drive as it grows.
dataloc.note: The move takes effect immediately, no restart needed. Original files are deleted after the move.

storage.title: Local cache (body + attachments)
storage.overLimit: Not enough space. The body/attachments you guarantee exceed the limit. Increase the limit or shorten the retention periods (the original is on the server).
storage.fullWindowHint: Attachment files are only stored locally when you download them. Within this period, downloaded attachments are kept; for older mail their files are removed locally (metadata stays; open/download re-fetches on demand, and an opened attachment lingers ~3 days). Starred mail is always kept.
storage.bodyWindowHint: Within this period, full bodies are downloaded (a little each sync) and kept locally even if you never open them. Older bodies are summarized (oldest first) only when the cache exceeds the limit — the new, unquoted part is kept and the heavy full body is dropped (re-fetchable from the server). "Always keep" covers all mail (up to the limit). Years can be any number.
storage.rebuildHint: Checks the recorded data-format version and picks what is needed automatically: re-imports everything from the server when the import format is outdated (including uid/attachment backfill); otherwise rebuilds quote separation and threading from the stored bodies only (no network).
storage.rebuildResync: The import format has been updated — re-importing everything from the server
